hook: Only 35% of working Americans have an emergency fund right now.

sections.voiceover: Only 35% of working Americans have an emergency fund right now.
b_roll: A bank vault door closing slowly.
A stack of empty dollar bills.

sections.voiceover: The Penny Hoarder published the October 2026 State of Savings survey with Katie Sartoris and Tiffany Connors. Where did the missing funds go?
b_roll: A digital survey form glowing on a tablet screen.
A financial report document resting on a wooden desk.

sections.voiceover: The Penny Hoarder survey published by Katie Sartoris and Tiffany Connors shows more data.
b_roll: A red warning symbol flashing on a computer monitor.

sections.voiceover: The survey revealed that 44% lack $1,000 in emergency savings. Katie Sartoris and Tiffany Connors published the survey on October 1, 2026. Yahoo Finance published The Penny Hoarder survey on October 1, 2026.
b_roll: A coin dropping into an empty glass jar.

sections.voiceover: Only 35% of workers across the country kept that money in reserve.
b_roll: A single coin resting at the bottom of a jar.
